title: Output-contract QA harness for JSON-mode edge cases
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Create a focused QA harness that stresses JSON-mode enforcement, constrained-decoding behavior, and schema adherence across streaming + function-calling flows. The goal is to catch regressions and flaky behaviors introduced by kernel/decoder changes, streaming chunk boundaries, and compatibility layers (old clients vs new runtime). Harness should produce deterministic failure artifacts (prompt, seed, model config), surface schema validation diffs, and be automatable in CI with failing-test artifacts uploaded to debug storage.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run as a CI job that produces a reproducible failure bundle (prompt, model flags, seed, captured stream).

At least 60 targeted scenarios covering: complete JSON-only outputs, truncated streams that span structural tokens, function-call payloads with nested objects, and intentionally malformed outputs for schema validation.
Property-based fuzzing integration that finds at least one new edge-case regression against current runtime within the PR gate (or documents why none found).
Compatibility checks that assert identical canonical parse (or documented divergence) between legacy decoding path and new constrained-decoding implementation for a representative subset of prompts.
Clear triage playbook and automated issue creation when harness finds a high-severity schema regression affecting customer-facing endpoints.
test_plan: Unit tests for the constrained-decoder wrapper to assert token-level constraints and graceful fallback paths.
Integration tests that spin up a mocked tool endpoint and validate function-call JSON payloads when streaming with partial chunks.
E2E scenarios using a curated corpus of customer-inspired prompts (edge nesting, escaped delimiters, interleaved text + json).
Property-based fuzzing (Hypothesis-like) that mutates schema shapes and streaming cut points to surface parser or validator crashes.
Backcompat matrix test: run each scenario against old runtime image and new runtime image and produce a diff report highlighting behavioral deltas.
implementation_notes: Extend the existing structured-output-validator binary with a 'ci-harness' subcommand that can replay streams and produce canonicalized JSON + validation diff.
Use deterministic PRNG seeds and mock clocks to ensure streaming chunk timing can be reproduced in CI artifacts.
Mock tool endpoints locally instead of hitting prod tooling; emulate common error responses (500, partial JSON, late tool-call invocation).
Prioritize tests that historically caused regressions: long KV caches with prefix reuse, batched inference paths, and model-config toggles related to temperature/top-k.
Trade-off: full-scale fuzzing is expensive; start with focused corpus + targeted property fuzzers. Gradually expand to nightly-wide runs.
